correctness.rationale: For every k>=2, the recurrence T_k(w)=(w1,...,w{k-1},w0+w{k-1}^2) over F3 is bijective. For each d|k the T_k^(4d)-fixed bi-infinite recurrence divides into d columns and four rows. Even reduced delay k/d modulo 4 forces no nonzero indicator. Odd reduced delay forces exactly one zero per column (or all-zero word), with two possible zero-row increments and a cyclic boundary shift. This yields the exact residue-class binomial expressions F_k(d); counting zeros per orbit forces every nonzero least short period to be 4d, and Mobius inversion gives C_k(4d)=(4d)^(-1) sum_{e|d} mu(d/e)(F_k(e)-1). The fourth-root-of-unity filter gives 2^k all-minimum period 4k for k a power of 2 at least 4. Independent *direct* state iteration over every 3^k state for k=2..10 (not reuse of verifier) reproduced each divisor fixed-count formula and counts k=9: one 12-cycle, thirteen 36-cycles; k=10: one 8-cycle, twenty-seven 40-cycles. Source C++ verifier inspected separately. Finite experiments do not prove all k; all-k argument is the row/column proof.
